text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Narita Brian and Biwa Hayahide at
a ramen
shop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, that hit the spot.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'm going to call it here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're going already? Don't you want to
let your
food settle first?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it's you. No, we just happened to
both be
here.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! Let me know when you're
ready to
order!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
We've got a special on offer! The Roast
Pork
Mountain!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious. Every single bite was so
juicy, it was
almost like meat broth.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you a bit too focused on meat?
You even
put all your veggies in my
bowl.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Did not.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You did too! I saw you! You need to eat
some
vegetables too!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! As long as you enjoyed it, I'm
happy!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
If you liked it that much, how about
some extra
pork? On the house.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose you're right. Eating too much
just will
just slow me down.
choice_data_list: Why don't you take them up on that offer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I think that's a wise decision.
You give
good advice, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch. What a meaningless remark. You're
trying
too hard to play the part of big
sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, I am your big sister...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Brian! We're not racing back! Slow
down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch the amusing exchange
between the
sisters, I order myself the
Roast Pork Mountain.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...That's what I'm talking about. Gotta
finish every
last bite!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's absurd! You're just going to eat
the pork
plain?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Why not? Hey, I'll take you up on that
extra pork!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. That was more than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The owner was so impressed with you
that he kept
bringing more...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to be okay? You've
clearly
exceeded the appropriate
amount of food for the
day...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's not a problem... In any case... I'll burn
it off
running in no time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Narita Brian certainly seems to
have had
her fill of roast pork, she may
have overdone it...
